description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultTimeoutConfig class, which provides configuration details for timeout settings including minimum and maximum durations. It implements the TimeoutConfig interface and reads configuration values from a config source, providing methods for access, equality comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultTimeoutConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of TimeoutConfig that provides min and max timeout durations based on external configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultTimeoutConfig from a given Config object.
